annotations.text:
Main poster is the deliverable.

Seven capabilities, numbered 01–07.
01 gets the wide hero tile because the hierarchy is what everything else hangs off.

NAS carries a PLANNED chip inside tile 02 — it is the one thing on here that does not exist yet.

Two alternates, low-fi on purpose.

B — paper/editorial, features as a numbered index. Calmer, reads like a spec sheet.

C — the app itself dominates, features shrink to a caption strip. Shows rather than tells, but needs a real screenshot to land.
